goal.objective: Complete Ecosystem Chat activation through a StegVerse-local/private model process and the sovereign ephemeral E1-to-worker-to-E2 carrier with same-execution Master Records reconstruction and no third-party production dependency.
success_predicates: A real local model process executes on a StegVerse-owned or federated node
The inference endpoint is loopback/private/StegVerse-local only
The sovereign ephemeral E1-to-worker-to-E2 execution path is observed
Provider-usage reconstruction passes in Master Records
Transition reconstruction passes for the same execution
GitHub Models, Render, Cloudflare and hosted inference are not required
failure_predicates: A fixture or synthetic response is treated as live model activation
A public hosted endpoint becomes the production inference authority
A third-party platform outage blocks StegVerse production activation
The worker repeats missing inference evidence without selecting or executing another local model/runtime path
Provider output is treated as governance or execution authority

task.derivation_reason: The remaining Ecosystem Chat activation work is heartbeat-worker managed and solution-seeking rather than chat-owned or passive observation. Sovereign runtime readiness is a completion predicate, not permission to stop trying alternate local inference paths.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while unfinished; absent activation evidence requires selecting and advancing an alternate local/private model path rather than repeating observation-only rechecks

completion.next_authorized_action: Select an executable StegVerse-local model/runtime combination and activate it. If the preferred model cannot run on available sovereign hardware, choose a smaller compatible local model or another StegVerse-owned/federated node rather than using hosted inference as a blocker or required dependency.
terminal_when: SHWP-DURABLE-RUNTIME-ACTIVATION is verified or equivalent sovereign node runtime evidence is present

block.problem_statement: No admitted StegVerse-local inference execution has yet satisfied all real-model, private-endpoint, E1-to-E2, measured-usage, and reconstruction predicates.
workaround_candidates: Start the preferred compatible local model on the sovereign carrier
Select a smaller compatible local model if hardware is insufficient
Move inference execution to another StegVerse-owned/federated node while preserving private transport and reconstruction semantics
block.machine_observable_release_condition: node-local ecosystem-chat activation.latest.json reports all real inference and same-execution reconstruction predicates true
